absence-notes.note: footnotes recording that no publicly readable source was found

absence-notes-never-searched.note: absence notes whose text says no query was ever run for that assertion - backlog, not a failed hunt

citation-notes.note: footnotes carrying a key link, a public page and a quoted passage

grounds-notes.note: footnotes recording that no source is owed

inventory-items.note: every sentence the four readers named; reproduces each report's own stated total

marker-classifier-disagreement.note: items this parser and the readers' own stated splits classify differently

worklist-high.note: the same, using this parser's marker classification - the wider bound

worklist-high-confidence.note: of the parsed remainder, the readers' HIGH confidence share

worklist-low.note: the remainder using the readers' own marker counts, less the classes 238 closed by hand
